raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On gfx95/gfx1250, DeepSeek V4 can select fused Q/K normalization and RoPE while `SGLANG_USE_AITER=0`. When the non-e8m0 producer is selected, both Q-LoRA prepare paths call the fused quantizer, although `fused_rms_fp8_group_quant` is imported only when AITER is enabled. This raises `NameError` before attention preparation completes.

## Modifications

Gate the AITER-dependent producer on the AITER switch and reuse the existing normalization/projection fallback when it is disabled. Keep the independent e8m0 producer available and preserve the downstream Q/K normalization, RoPE and cache-store path. Add a regression test for both prepare methods and the AITER/e8m0 choices.

## Accuracy Tests

On MI355X, PyTorch 2.11.0 with ROCm, using upstream `5007cbd6a57515bf5e008ff2fd2bdb834356b53c` and the patch:

- Both real prepare methods at batch sizes 1 and 5: all four AITER-off baseline cases reproduce the exact `NameError`; all four patched cases pass normalization, Q/RoPE, KV-cache and indexer checks using real block-FP8 projections.
- AITER-on: four base/head pairs complete, with all saved outputs compared byte-for-byte by the validation runner.
- Existing e8m0 tests pass: eight producer and two consumer cases, with no skips.
- The same 12-case dispatch regression yields four expected baseline failures and no patched failures.

These are fixed-weight component tests using DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP8 configuration dimensions, not full-model accuracy or gfx1250 hardware results. AITER is installed; the disabled-switch cases use the existing Triton block-FP8 path.

The branch is aligned with upstream `68e57f40057175ff22a17ea0bdbe7ecbc69d9d91`; the changed model file and regression test are byte-identical to the GPU-validated versions. The local dispatch control was rerun after alignment; GPU results belong to the stated baseline.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance improvement is claimed. This fixes a failing dispatch and leaves the AITER-on producer unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""Q-LoRA producer selection with the optional AITER path disabled."""
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=10, suite="stage-a-test-1-gpu-small-amd")
+
+
+class TestFusedQuantDispatch(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_prepare_producers(self):
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention import fused_qk_norm_rope_store as store
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsv4 import unified_kv_gate
+        from sglang.srt.models import deepseek_v4 as model
+
+        x = torch.tensor([[1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0], [4.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0]])
+        norm = torch.nn.RMSNorm(4, eps=1e-6)
+        norm.variance_epsilon = 1e-6
+        expected = norm(x)
+        quantized = (expected, torch.ones(2, 1))
+
+        for gfx1250 in (False, True):
+            for multi_stream in (False, True):
+                for aiter, e8m0 in ((False, False), (True, False), (False, True)):
+                    with (
+                        self.subTest(
+                            gfx1250=gfx1250,
+                            multi_stream=multi_stream,
+                            aiter=aiter,
+                            e8m0=e8m0,
+                        ),
+                        ExitStack() as stack,
+                    ):
+                        fused = stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(
+                                model,
+                                "_fused_rmsnorm_fp8_quant",
+                                return_value=(quantized, expected),
+                            )
+                        )
+                        if not (aiter or e8m0):
+                            fused.side_effect = AssertionError(
+                                "AITER producer disabled"
+                            )
+                        for name, value in (
+                            ("_use_aiter", aiter),
+                            ("_is_gfx95_supported", not gfx1250),
+                            ("_is_gfx1250_supported", gfx1250),
+                            ("_is_npu", False),
+                        ):
+                            stack.enter_context(mock.patch.object(model, name, value))
+                        stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(model, "is_cp_active", return_value=False)
+                        )
+                        stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(
+                                model,
+                                "get_token_to_kv_pool",
+                                return_value=mock.Mock(swa_page_size=1),
+                            )
+                        )
+                        stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(
+                                unified_kv_gate,
+                                "is_unified_kv_triton",
+                                return_value=False,
+                            )
+                        )
+                        stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(
+                                unified_kv_gate, "is_unified_kv_fp8", return_value=False
+                            )
+                        )
+                        stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(
+                                model.envs.SGLANG_OPT_FUSED_QK_NORM_ROPE_VERIFY,
+                                "get",
+                                return_value=False,
+                            )
+                        )
+                        stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(
+                                torch.cuda, "current_stream", return_value=mock.Mock()
+                            )
+                        )
+                        fused_store = stack.enter_context(
+                            mock.patch.object(
+                                store,
+                                "fused_qk_norm_rope_swa_store",
+                                side_effect=lambda **kw: kw["q"],
+                            )
+                        )
+                        projection = mock.Mock(
+                            side_effect=lambda value: (
+                                value[0] if isinstance(value, tuple) else value,
+                                None,
+                            )
+                        )
+                        layer = SimpleNamespace(
+                            alt_streams=[mock.Mock()],
+                            compressor=None,
+                            indexer=mock.Mock(),
+                            fuse_wqa_wkv=False,
+                            wq_a=lambda value: (value, None),
+                            wq_b=projection,
+                            wkv=lambda value: (value, None),
+                            q_norm=norm,
+                            kv_norm=norm,
+                            eps=1e-6,
+                            qk_rope_head_dim=0,
+                            cos_cache=None,
+                            sin_cache=None,
+                            layer_id=0,
+                            compress_ratio=4,
+                            use_fused_qk_norm_rope=True,
+                            _q_lora_quant_e8m0=mock.Mock(return_value=e8m0),
+                            _normalize_q_lora=lambda value: (norm(value), norm(value)),
+                        )
+                        batch = mock.Mock()
+                        batch.forward_mode.is_decode_or_idle.return_value = True
+                        batch.forward_mode.is_target_verify.return_value = False
+                        method = (
+                            model.MQALayer._forward_prepare_multi_stream_hip
+                            if multi_stream
+                            else model.MQALayer._forward_prepare
+                        )
+                        result = method(layer, x, torch.arange(2), batch, mock.Mock())
+                        q = result if multi_stream else result[0]
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(q, expected)
+                        actual = projection.call_args.args[0]
+                        if aiter or e8m0:
+                            self.assertIs(actual, quantized)
+                            fused.assert_called_once_with(
+                                x, norm.weight, 1e-6, e8m0=e8m0
+                            )
+                        else:
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected)
+                            fused.assert_not_called()
+                        layer._q_lora_quant_e8m0.assert_called_once_with(
+                            with_indexer=not multi_stream
+                        )
+                        torch.testing.assert_close(
+                            layer.indexer.call_args.kwargs["q_lora"], expected
+                        )
+                        if not multi_stream:
+                            self.assertIs(
+                                layer.indexer.call_args.kwargs["q_lora_quant"],
+                                quantized if aiter or e8m0 else None,
+                            )
+                        fused_store.assert_called_once()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
